sections.heading: What Rankwarden is
sections.summary: A free fan site with World of Warcraft rankings, built from public game data.

blocks.p: Rankwarden shows PvP and PvE rankings, characters, guilds, cutoffs, tier lists and statistics for World of Warcraft. Its data comes from Blizzard Entertainment's official API and from Raider.io, and is collected and served by our own API. The service is free and needs no account.
You must be at least 13 years old to use Rankwarden. If the law where you live sets a higher age for using online services without a parent's consent, you need that consent too.

sections.heading: Game data and its accuracy
sections.summary: We show what Blizzard and Raider.io report, which can be late, incomplete or wrong.

blocks.p: Rankings, ratings and character details come from Blizzard and Raider.io and depend on their availability and correctness. Data can be delayed, incomplete or occasionally wrong, and we may correct, change or remove it at any time without notice. Don't rely on Rankwarden as the official record; the game and Blizzard's services are.
If you want your character or guild removed from Rankwarden, see our [Privacy Policy](/privacy).
